lifecycle: start writes a proposal draft through commit
lifecycle: preview produces quantities and a finite section delta
lifecycle: accept commits version-2 fields once and clears proposal
lifecycle: accepted v2 steel is explicit-design steel, not legacy formula
delta: steel delta equals proposed minus current item steel
delta: section rows report held-aware totals (unpriceable cabinet held at saved)
discard: removes draft, leaves every legacy field byte-identical
blocked: start/preview/accept refuse and commit nothing
blocked: missing acknowledged source refuses proposal edits
stale: concurrent project change invalidates preview and refuses accept
stale: wrong proposal id refuses accept
held: version-1 item on legacy path is never silently re-dispatched
held: unsupported version keeps acknowledged snapshot, no legacy fallback
draft: malformed raw values reach preview as issues, never commit silently
